wireContract: Spec 012 §5.3.13.3.1. Adds browser-session-only POST /communities/:communityId/spaces-ownership/start with exact JSON {idempotency_key,canonical_root} and POST /communities/:communityId/spaces-ownership/poll with exact JSON {ceremony_id,idempotency_key,signature_hex}. Start returns a bounded owner challenge or verification_pending. Poll returns verification_pending, verified evidence, or a terminal rejection. The owner wallet signs only on the owner device. The routes are not composed in production until scoped verifier credentials and the installed verifier wire are accepted.
